asset.name: Certificate expiring soon
asset.description: The reminder each learner gets from the Training results page when their certificate expires soon.
asset.subject: Your {{cert.course_title}} certificate expires on {{cert.certificate_expires}}

Time to refresh your training

Hi {{cert.learner_name}},

Your certificate {{cert.certificate_no}} for {{cert.course_title}} expires on {{cert.certificate_expires}}. Take the course and its quiz again before then to stay certified.
